fields.access: none in the original Gate lifecycle
fields.evidence: Complete direct-call inventories, nine exact instruction-region hashes, and all 18 overlay-7 callers of the pure ARM9 Gate-bonus accessor contain no activation-history increment or read.
mutations: none
fields.name: gate_activation_count
fields.owner_structure: none in the original Gate lifecycle
fields.player_ai_behavior: Not applicable in the original system; the bounded absence is shared across human and AI battle construction.
fields.replacement_plan: Reserve activation_count_by_arena_entry[12] as unsigned saturating bytes at offsets 0x2C..0x37 of the approved future 64-byte overlay-7 match-local BSS cache at 0x02293C20..0x02293C60. Reset at session construction, initialize on arena allocation, increment once after canonical Gate identity is known during battle construction, reset when active-placement identity changes, and clear on arena removal. Do not repurpose original object or save-data bytes.
fields.scripted_behavior: No normal or scripted Gate setup, battle-construction, result, transfer, removal, or reset path maintains activation history.

fields.access: participant +0x56 + gate_slot_index * 4; +0xF8 is a supporting ordinary availability cache
fields.evidence: The ordinary selector chooses only state-0 slots; allocation writes 1, transfer restores the old slot to 0 and assigns the replacement slot 1, removal writes 2, and scripted setup may preassign 2.
fields.initialization: Participant constructor 0x022696B4 clears Gate-slot records to state 0 and initializes +0xF8 from configured Gate count.
mutations: 0 to 1 when an ordinary selectable Gate slot is assigned to an active arena placement.
1 or 2 to 0 only when active-placement transfer releases the previous owner slot.
Any nonzero state to 2 when the arena placement is removed.
Scripted setup at 0x0226A48C may assign state 2 and directly override +0xF8.
fields.name: gate_reuse_state
fields.player_ai_behavior: The same slot-state setter and ordinary selector apply to human and AI participants.
fields.reset: New participant construction is the authoritative reset; destruction frees the object without clearing it in place.
fields.scripted_behavior: Scripted setup can preassign state 2 and force +0xF8 to zero, so +0xF8 is not a universal derived count.

fields.access: winner participant +0xEE and +0xF4 with ledger at +0x84; owner Gate-slot state participates after capture bookkeeping
fields.evidence: The normal result increments winner match score, appends capture history, increments its count, then removes the active placement. This is a composite capture event rather than a single per-Gate Boolean flag.
fields.initialization: Participant construction clears +0xEE, +0xF4, the capture ledger, and Gate-slot records; scripted setup may seed score or slot availability afterward.
fields.lifetime: Participant object / match session, including result and post-result presentation.
mutations: Normal result increments the settled winner score at +0xEE.
Normal and alternate result paths append a six-byte capture-history record and increment winner +0xF4.
The active Gate owner's slot is written to unavailable state 2 during arena removal.
fields.name: gate_capture_state
fields.owner_structure: participant match-state, capture-history ledger, and owner Gate-slot records
fields.player_ai_behavior: Winner-relative bookkeeping is shared by human and AI participants.
fields.reset: Participant construction resets score, capture ledger, and Gate slots; destruction ends validity.
fields.scripted_behavior: Specialized result writers and scripted score or slot seeding are documented separately; no single state-2 byte alone proves capture.

fields.access: session arena entry +0x02 with board-grid reference and session +0x294
fields.evidence: The controlled 4B runtime boundary changed occupied 1 to 0, its board-grid reference 1 to 0, and session +0x294 from 1 to 0 while descriptor cleanup had not yet run.
fields.initialization: Session construction at 0x0225FD5C clears arena records, board-grid state, and session +0x294.
mutations: Arena allocation at 0x02262638 sets occupied to 1, records owner and slot identity, updates the board grid, and increments +0x294.
Arena removal at 0x022626B8 sets occupied to 0, clears the board-grid reference, writes owner slot state 2, and decrements +0x294.
Active-placement transfer at 0x02262714 changes owner and slot identity without clearing occupied or changing +0x294.
fields.name: gate_removal_state
fields.player_ai_behavior: Removal is keyed by canonical arena entry and owner slot, independent of human or AI control identity.
fields.reset: Session construction clears the table and placement count; session teardown invalidates all addresses.
fields.scripted_behavior: Scripted setup may preassign participant slot state, but the common arena occupied byte and board-grid clear still define physical removal.

safe_extension_storage: Future overlay-7 match-local BSS cache 0x02293C20..0x02293C60; activation_count_by_arena_entry[12] occupies offsets 0x2C..0x37 and is not implemented during Milestone 6B.

transitions: Participant construction clears Gate-slot records to state 0 and initializes the ordinary +0xF8 availability cache.
Session construction clears twelve arena-placement entries, board-grid references, session +0x294, and descriptor state.
Ordinary arena allocation selects a state-0 Gate slot, marks it state 1, creates an occupied arena entry, and increments active-placement count.
Battle construction derives canonical Gate ID and owner from the arena entry without incrementing any activation-history field.
Result finalization updates winner score and capture history before physical arena removal.
Arena removal clears occupied and board-grid state, writes owner Gate-slot state 2, and decrements active-placement count.
Active-placement transfer releases the old slot to 0, replaces owner and Gate-slot identity, and assigns the replacement slot state 1 while keeping the arena entry occupied.
Scripted setup may preassign Gate-slot state 2 and override +0xF8, bypassing ordinary availability bookkeeping.
Destruction invalidates participant and session objects; new construction is the authoritative reset.
